On 1/20/13 5:09 PM, Andrew Gelman wrote:

> This is another model that could be could in our intro-stan document.

I'll add a measurement error chapter with a regression
example and also discuss 8 schools. So far,
8 schools is in the RStan doc, but not in the Stan manual.

- Bob


> On Jan 20, 2013, at 4:57 PM, Bob Carpenter wrote:
>
>> What Andrew said. Switching back to Devin's variable names
>> and writing out in Stan, you need:
>>
>> data {
>> int<lower=0> N; // number of cases
>> vector[N] x; // measurment with error
>> vector<lower=0>[N]; // measurement deviation
>> vector[N] y; // observed outcomes
>> ...
>> parameters {
>> vector[N] x_new; // measurement plus noise
>> }
>> model {
>> x_new ~ normal(x,s);
>>
>> for (n in 1:N)
>> y[n] ~ ... x_new[n] ... // use measurement plus noise
>> }
...
